name: horrible-shrimp
description: A compact outlined switch with a 1em pill track and a circular thumb that lifts on hover and slides when on.
purpose: Toggles a persistent on or off preference with a tactile, hard-outline control that stays readable in light and dark.
bestFor: settings rows that need a visible on and off state
notification or feature flags in compact forms
demo surfaces that want a physical switch without extra chrome
avoidFor: multi-option choices that need a radio group
destructive confirmations that should use a button
